name: authoring-judge-gate
description: Preview judge gates the green-preview auto-commit on the user's GOAL: the 'Project: ()' wrong-content fixture (empty project names) is blocked with the missing items listed; the correct fixture (names + droplet specs present) passes and auto-commits.

input.goal: Email me the DigitalOcean resources per project: include project names and droplet specs (CPU, memory, disk).

failed_verdict.reason: Project names are empty and droplet specs are absent from the previewed email.

passing_verdict.reason: Output contains project names and droplet specs.
